claims.text: Twenty unique GCOV acquisitions support four investigation study windows: ten Nepal dates and ten shared Bangladesh dates. The Bangladesh record includes all ten available nominal visits in the displayed June–October interval.
claims.limitation: Both crops in each country share their source acquisitions. The August 5 Bangladesh slot is a permanent satellite outage. Historical products remain separately addressable.

claims.text: In the 199-pixel Nepal footprint, HH baseline differences remain −7.5263 and −7.0766 dB while centered-score retained alert area falls from 0.0199 km² to zero.
claims.limitation: Alert contraction, baseline persistence and physical recovery are distinct; cause is unresolved.

claims.text: Original nominal pair areas remain 0.0195, 0.7949 and 0.0000 km² under their original rule.
claims.limitation: These are not the centered-score tracked-zone areas.

claims.text: The Nepal footprint has CPR baseline changes of +5.7152 dB and +4.6256 dB on the two follow-up visits.
claims.limitation: CPR is HV−HH in dB, the sign reversal of the existing HH−HV relation; not independent corroboration.

claims.text: Case-wide median slope is 1.9495° at Jamuna and 1.3598° at Tanguar.
claims.limitation: Terrain/geometry screening and bounded hydrology are contextual models, not validated hazard or visibility classes.

claims.text: Frozen IMERG Final-product rain totals remain unavailable. A later NASA catalog search found Late V07 candidates, but no scientific rainfall files were supplied or imported in this batch.
claims.limitation: Exact UTC windows remain implemented. Missing rain stays null; catalog availability does not create precipitation measurements. NASA multisensor lineage still requires review before the strict source policy can accept an import.

claims.text: The August dip remains unresolved after frozen putative-control and full-source histogram tests.
claims.limitation: Control shifts do not establish calibration error or physical cause.

claims.text: Versioned deterministic rules show supporting, contradicting and missing evidence for competing explanations.
claims.limitation: Uncalibrated compatibility statuses, no probability, winning cause or runtime LLM.

claims.text: Fixed-footprint Change DNA records signed channel changes, observed-visit persistence, onset/recovery brackets and censored recovery for saved or user-selected regions.
claims.limitation: Numeric footprint records are dynamically recomputed with source/rule provenance; retrospective selection is not independent validation.

claims.text: Low-return, paired brightening, moisture/roughness, vegetation, steep-source movement and radiometric explanations remain candidate hypotheses.
claims.limitation: Signature compatibility does not uniquely identify a physical process.

claims.text: The original frozen descriptive HLS comparison has eligible optical pixels in 14 of 54 footprint/date comparisons; 40 remain unavailable. The four added Bangladesh radar dates have no newly accepted optical matches.
claims.limitation: Only the preselected geographic footprints and eligible pixels were assessed. Mixed results are retained; this is algorithmic optical context, not classification accuracy or causal validation.

claims.text: Two supplied Nepal GUNW products now provide measured native 20 m and 80 m HH coherence for August 19–31 and August 31–September 12 in both Nepal crops.
claims.limitation: Pairwise coherence is not displacement or a unique physical cause. Original Change DNA and Bangladesh retain their original unavailable coherence inputs. Reference-point, correction and unwrap checks are still required before LOS displacement.

claims.text: The corridor intersects about 6.4230 km² of preliminary mapped mudflow/rockflow impact context.
claims.limitation: This overlap does not establish detection accuracy, flood-water truth or field validation.

claims.text: Illustrative numerical settings describe measurements and display, not independently calibrated classes.
claims.limitation: Configuration parameters must not be presented as validated physical thresholds.

claims.text: Shared navigation and investigation links preserve supported case, observed date, saved or selected footprint, mode and layer state. Three Movements opens the existing measured evidence.
claims.limitation: Nepal-only workspaces stay explicitly scoped. Unsupported legacy layers/footprints or missing dates are disclosed instead of being treated as equivalent data.

claims.text: Keyboard map inspection and polygon vertices, visible focus, reduced-motion styles and live text evidence are implemented.
claims.limitation: Source checks and mocked interactions do not establish real-browser, assistive-technology, GPU or whole-app WCAG conformance.

claims.text: Checked local page assets and representative reasoning requests work through the HTTP handler while Python sockets and DNS are forbidden.
claims.limitation: This is a scoped automated backend/source check. Browser network behavior and a physically disconnected rehearsal remain unverified.

claims.text: The portable release builder includes current runtime rules, claims and local assets and checks every archive entry against its manifest.
claims.limitation: Dependency installation, clean judging-machine startup, browser/physical rehearsal, public repository/video access and actual submission remain separate acceptance steps.

claims.text: The original 199-pixel Nepal footprint remains common-valid across ten visits; its October 18 HH difference from August 19 is about −6.5660 dB.
claims.limitation: This extends the measured backscatter record. Earlier visits vary relative to August 19, which is not a verified undisturbed baseline. No continuous persistence, physical damage or recovery is established.

claims.text: The ten-visit Bangladesh record recomputes HH/HV differences, dual-polarization signatures, observed occupancy, sensitivity, controls and fixed-footprint evidence. Only the August 5 nominal slot remains unobserved.
claims.limitation: Added dates improve temporal sampling; they do not establish water, erosion, habitat, causal or hazard accuracy. No new coherence, scientific rain or thermal observations were supplied.
